instruction: Save the EleutherAI blog article to my bookmarks bar so I can find it easily.

metadata.explanation: Task requires bookmarking the EleutherAI blog post (first tab) to the bookmark bar. Uses the existing is_expected_bookmarks metric. Same difficulty as variation 1 with different instruction wording.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic (get_bookmarks) correctly reads Chrome Bookmarks file and extracts bookmark_bar structure
Metric logic (is_expected_bookmarks) correctly handles 'bookmark_bar_websites_urls' type, extracting URLs from bookmark_bar children and using subset check
Complete coverage: instruction requires bookmarking ONE specific URL to bookmark bar, evaluator checks for exactly that URL
Expected value is semantically correct: 'https://blog.eleuther.ai/rotary-embeddings/' matches the first tab in config, which is the EleutherAI blog article referenced in instruction
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure bookmarks are flushed to disk (necessary for reliable verification)
Practical feasibility: getter can access Bookmarks file, metric can parse and compare data correctly
